Date of Appointment- October 20, 2026

Brief Profile (in case of Appointment)

Mr. Kundip S. Thakker is a finance professional with over 26
years of experience in financial management, strategic
planning, corporate finance, treasury, fundraising, financial
controls and business performance management across
diverse industries.
Most recently, he was Chief Financial Officer of Stelmec
Limited, Mumbai, a medium-voltage switchgear and smart
power solutions company. There he led financial strategy,
controls, fundraising, investor relations and IPO
preparedness, including a private equity raise of ₹175 crore
in 2024.

3.

Term of Appointment- Not applicable, since the CFO is
appointed as a full-time employee of the Company

Before joining Stelmec in June 2024, he spent about ten
years at Blue Star Limited as Head – Treasury & Shared
Services (P2P), where he managed treasury and banking
operations, working capital, foreign exchange exposure,
trade finance and banking limits of about ₹6,000 crore
across 16 banks, and capital raising, including a ₹1,000 crore
QIP in September 2023. Earlier, he held senior finance and
commercial roles at Black Box Limited (Essar Group), ABB
Limited, Reliance Industries Limited, Navneet Education
Limited and Borkar Packaging Private Limited.
He has received the CFO of the Year (2025), Finance Leader
of the Year (2025) and Best Treasurer of the Year (2024)
awards from [name of awarding body].
